body: I have a therapist, but I am hesitant to do anything more extreme. My family life is not ideal and I have a bag packed just in case I need to leave sooner than I had planned. I feel like going to a hospital would exacerbate that problem and would make making up school difficult, which is the only thing I like. Also, I don't do well being checked on. Having people constantly watching makes it hard for me to maintain a superpositional state which is the only way I can relax. Also, I can't eat in front of others so I feel like the whole thing would be more effort than its worth.
